ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Purchase:
-- Prompt only verified Creator Dashboard listings; receipts grant products on the server.
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PolicyService = game:GetService("PolicyService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Monetization = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Monetization)
local Zones = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Zones)

local Purchase = {}
local listingCache = {}

local function listing(kind, item)
    if item.Id == 0 then return false, "Listing not set up" end
    local infoType = if kind == "Pass" then Enum.InfoType.GamePass else Enum.InfoType.Product
    local ok, info = pcall(MarketplaceService.GetProductInfo, MarketplaceService, item.Id, infoType)
    if not ok or not info then return false, "Roblox price unavailable; try again" end
    local actual = info.PriceInRobux
    if type(actual) ~= "number" or actual > Monetization.MaxRobux or actual ~= item.Price then
        return false, "Listing price does not match the shop"
    end
    if info.IsForSale == false then return false, "Item is not on sale" end
    return true
end

function Purchase.Pass(key)
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    local item = Monetization.Passes[key]
    if not item then return false, "Unknown pass" end
    if player:GetAttribute("Pass_" .. key) then return false, "Already owned" end
    local ok, reason = listing("Pass", item)
    if not ok then return false, reason end
    local prompted,err=pcall(MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchase,MarketplaceService,player,item.Id)
    if not prompted then return false,"Roblox purchase prompt unavailable; try again" end
    return true
end

function Purchase.Product(key)
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    local item = Monetization.Products[key]
    if not item then return false, "Unknown product" end
    if not player:GetAttribute("Loaded") then return false,"Progress is still loading" end
    if not player:GetAttribute("DataPersistent") then return false,"Purchases wait until progress saving is available" end
    if key == "WorldSkip" and (player:GetAttribute("AllowedZone") or 1) >= #Zones.List then
        return false, "All current worlds already unlocked"
    end
    if key == "MegaEgg" or key == "UltraEgg" then
        local ok, policy = pcall(PolicyService.GetPolicyInfoForPlayerAsync, PolicyService, player)
        if not ok or policy.ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted then
            return false, "Paid random eggs are unavailable for this player"
        end
    end
    local ok, reason = listing("Product", item)
    if not ok then return false, reason end
    local prompted,err=pcall(MarketplaceService.PromptProductPurchase,MarketplaceService,player,item.Id)
    if not prompted then return false,"Roblox purchase prompt unavailable; try again" end
    return true
end

function Purchase.PriceText(kind, key)
    local item = if kind == "Pass" then Monetization.Passes[key] else Monetization.Products[key]
    if not item then return "UNAVAILABLE" end
    if item.Id == 0 then return "COMING SOON" end
    local cacheKey = kind .. tostring(item.Id)
    local cached = listingCache[cacheKey]
    if not cached or os.clock() - cached.time > 60 then
        local ok, reason = listing(kind, item)
        cached = {time = os.clock(), ok = ok, reason = reason}
        listingCache[cacheKey] = cached
    end
    return if cached.ok then "R$" .. item.Price else "UNAVAILABLE"
end

return Purchase

ServerScriptService.Services.DataService:
-- Ordered durable profiles with cross-server leases; Studio saves stay separate from live.
local DataStoreService=game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local HttpService=game:GetService("HttpService")
local DataService={}
local STORE_NAME=if RunService:IsStudio() then "StatSim_v1_Studio" else "StatSim_v1"
local AUTOSAVE_SECONDS,LEASE_SECONDS=45,180
local profiles,sessions,loading={},{},{}
local store,started,shuttingDown=nil,false,false
local loadedEvent=Instance.new("BindableEvent")
DataService.ProfileLoaded=loadedEvent.Event

local function defaults()
 return {SchemaVersion=2,Strength=0,TotalStrength=0,XP=0,Level=1,Rebirths=0,Coins=0,
 BestPunch=0,PetInv={},NextPetUid=1,WorldUnlocked=1,BoostEnd=0,CoinBoostEnd=0,LuckEnd=0,
 AutoTrainOn=true,AutoPunchOn=true,AutoHatchOn=true,Receipts={},ReceiptOrder={},WorldSkipCredits=0}
end
local function copy(value)
 if type(value)~="table" then return value end
 local result={}
 for k,v in value do result[k]=copy(v) end
 return result
end
local function reconcile(value)
 assert(value==nil or type(value)=="table","Stored profile is not a table")
 local data=copy(value or {})
 for k,v in defaults() do
  if type(data[k])~=type(v) then data[k]=copy(v) end
  if type(v)=="number" and (data[k]~=data[k] or math.abs(data[k])==math.huge or data[k]<v) then data[k]=v end
 end
 data.SchemaVersion=2
 data._Session=nil
 return data
end
local function retries(fn)
 local err
 for attempt=1,3 do
  local ok,result=pcall(fn)
  if ok then return true,result end
  err=result
  if attempt<3 then task.wait(attempt) end
 end
 return false,err
end
local function key(player) return "player_"..player.UserId end
local function status(player,text,persistent)
 player:SetAttribute("DataStatus",text)
 player:SetAttribute("DataPersistent",persistent)
end
function DataService.Load(player)
 if loading[player] or sessions[player] or shuttingDown then return end
 loading[player]=true
 status(player,"Loading",false)
 local token=HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
 local data,err,ok,locked
 for attempt=1,5 do
  locked=false
  ok,err=retries(function()
   assert(store,"Data store unavailable")
   return store:UpdateAsync(key(player),function(old)
    local lease=type(old)=="table" and old._Session
    if lease and lease.Id~=token and type(lease.ExpiresAt)=="number" and lease.ExpiresAt>os.time() then
     locked=true
     return nil
    end
    local nextData=reconcile(old)
    nextData._Session={Id=token,ExpiresAt=os.time()+LEASE_SECONDS}
    return nextData
   end)
  end)
  if ok and err then data=err;break end
  if not locked or attempt==5 or not player.Parent then break end
  task.wait(2)
 end
 loading[player]=nil
 if data then
  profiles[player]=reconcile(data)
  sessions[player]={Token=token,Persistent=true,Busy=false,Closing=false}
  status(player,"Saved",true)
  player:SetAttribute("LastSaveAt",os.time())
 elseif RunService:IsStudio() and not locked then
  -- Explicit preview only: never acknowledges a purchase or writes defaults over real data.
  profiles[player]=defaults()
  sessions[player]={Persistent=false,Busy=false,Closing=false}
  status(player,"Session only - enable Studio API access",false)
  warn("[DataService] Studio data access unavailable; progress is session-only. "..tostring(err))
 else
  status(player,"Load failed",false)
  player:Kick(if locked then "Your previous server is still saving. Please rejoin in a moment." else "Saved progress could not be loaded. Please rejoin; your existing data has not been replaced.")
  return
 end
 if not player.Parent or shuttingDown then
  DataService.Save(player,true)
  profiles[player],sessions[player]=nil,nil
  return
 end
 loadedEvent:Fire(player,profiles[player])
end
function DataService.Get(player)
 local session=sessions[player]
 return if session and not session.Closing then profiles[player] else nil
end
function DataService.Save(player,release)
 local session=sessions[player]
 if not session or not profiles[player] or not session.Persistent then return false end
 if release then session.Closing=true end
 -- Snapshot is taken after waiting: stale autosaves cannot overwrite newer purchases.
 while session.Busy do task.wait() end
 if session.Released then return session.LastResult==true end
 session.Busy=true
 local snapshot=copy(profiles[player])
 snapshot.SavedAt=os.time()
 snapshot._Session=if release then nil else {Id=session.Token,ExpiresAt=os.time()+LEASE_SECONDS}
 status(player,"Saving",true)
 local lost=false
 local ok,result=retries(function()
  return store:UpdateAsync(key(player),function(old)
   if type(old)~="table" or type(old._Session)~="table" or old._Session.Id~=session.Token then
    lost=true
    return nil
   end
   return snapshot
  end)
 end)
 local saved=ok and result~=nil and not lost
 session.LastResult=saved
 if release and saved then session.Released=true end
 session.Busy=false
 if saved then
  player:SetAttribute("LastSaveAt",snapshot.SavedAt)
  status(player,"Saved",true)
 else
  status(player,"Save retry pending",not lost)
  warn("[DataService] Save failed for "..player.UserId..": "..tostring(result))
  if lost and player.Parent then player:Kick("Your data session moved to another server. Please rejoin to reload your latest progress.") end
 end
 return saved
end
function DataService.HasReceipt(profile,purchaseId) return profile.Receipts[tostring(purchaseId)]==true end
function DataService.AddReceipt(profile,purchaseId)
 -- Keep the receipt ledger; pruning old IDs can award a retried receipt twice.
 local id=tostring(purchaseId)
 if profile.Receipts[id] then return end
 profile.Receipts[id]=true
 table.insert(profile.ReceiptOrder,id)
end
function DataService.Start()
 if started then return end
 started=true
 local ok,result=pcall(function() return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(STORE_NAME) end)
 if ok then store=result end
 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(DataService.Load)
 for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do task.spawn(DataService.Load,player) end
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
  DataService.Save(player,true)
  profiles[player],sessions[player]=nil,nil
 end)
 game:BindToClose(function()
  shuttingDown=true
  local pending=0
  for player in profiles do
   pending+=1
   task.spawn(function() DataService.Save(player,true);pending-=1 end)
  end
  local deadline=os.clock()+26
  while pending>0 and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait() end
 end)
 task.spawn(function()
  while not shuttingDown do
   task.wait(AUTOSAVE_SECONDS)
   for player,session in sessions do
    if not session.Closing then task.spawn(DataService.Save,player) end
   end
  end
 end)
end
return DataService

-- Builds the HUD in code (UiStyle buttons) and keeps it in sync with player
-- attributes. Visual only: every stat, unlock and purchase is decided on the server.
-- Passive Strength arrives once a second but is shown as +gain popups every 0.1s
-- with a smooth counter, so it feels like it never stops going up.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Gym = require(Config:WaitForChild("Gym"))
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local HudController = {}

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
local CLICK_LIMIT = 12

local ui = {}
local clickTimes = {}
local shownStrength = 0
local lastLevel = nil

local function make(className, props, children)
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for k, v in props do
		inst[k] = v
	end
	for _, child in children or {} do
		child.Parent = inst
	end
	return inst
end

local function corner(radius)
	return make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 12)})
end

local function label(props)
	local l = make("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Font = FONT,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	}, {make("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.5, Color = DARK})})
	for k, v in props do
		l[k] = v
	end
	return l
end


local function button(name, text, color, size, parent, rainbow)
	local square = size.X.Offset > 0 and size.X.Offset == size.Y.Offset
	return UiStyle.Button({
		Name = name,
		Text = text,
		Color = color,
		Size = size,
		Shape = if square then "Square" else "Wide",
		Logo = if not square and size.X.Offset < 130 then nil else name,
		Rainbow = rainbow == true,
		Parent = parent,
	})
end

local function scaled(frame)
	local scale = make("UIScale", {Parent = frame})
	local function update()
		local size = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min(size.X / 1100, size.Y / 700), 0.55, 1)
	end
	update()
	workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update)
end

local function attr(name, default)
	local value = player:GetAttribute(name)
	if value == nil then
		return default
	end
	return value
end

local function optionalController(name)
	local module = script.Parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not module then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
	return if ok then result else nil
end

-- toasts and popups
local function notify(text)
	local toast = label({
		Text = text,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(620, 40),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 118),
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 120),
		Parent = ui.Gui,
	})
	TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 128)}):Play()
	task.delay(2.5, function()
		TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.4)
		toast:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function popup(text, color, big)
	local size = if big then UDim2.fromOffset(240, 46) else UDim2.fromOffset(140, 30)
	local p = label({
		Text = text,
		Size = size,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0, 0.42 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.18, 0),
		TextColor3 = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Rotation = (math.random() - 0.5) * 16,
		Parent = ui.Gui,
	})
	local goal = {Position = p.Position - UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.07), TextTransparency = 1}
	TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), goal):Play()
	task.delay(0.7, function()
		p:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function buyPass(passKey)
	local ok, reason = Purchase.Pass(passKey)
	if not ok and reason then
		notify(reason)
	end
end

local function buyProduct(productKey)
	local ok, reason = Purchase.Product(productKey)
	if not ok and reason then
		notify(reason)
	end
end

-- owned auto pass = toggle it, not owned = buy it
local function autoButton(passKey, field, remote)
	return function()
		if attr("Pass_" .. passKey, false) then
			remote:FireServer(not attr(field, true))
		else
			buyPass(passKey)
		end
	end
end

local function train()
	local now = os.clock()
	while clickTimes[1] and now - clickTimes[1] > 1 do
		table.remove(clickTimes, 1)
	end
	if #clickTimes >= CLICK_LIMIT then
		return
	end
	table.insert(clickTimes, now)
	Remotes.Train:FireServer()
	popup("+" .. Format.Number(attr("Gain", 1) * StatsConfig.ClickValue) .. " \u{1F4AA}", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90), true)
end

		clicks += StatsConfig.AutoClicks

function HudController.Start()
	buildHud()
	shownStrength = attr("Strength", 0)
	player.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(name)
		if name ~= "Strength" then
			refresh()
		end
	end)
	refresh()
	Remotes.Notify.OnClientEvent:Connect(notify)

	-- smooth counter: always creeping toward the real (server) value
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		local target = attr("Strength", 0)
		if target < shownStrength then
			shownStrength = target
		else
			shownStrength += (target - shownStrength) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
		end
		ui.StrengthText.Text = "STRENGTH  " .. Format.Number(shownStrength) .. "   +" .. Format.Number(passivePerSecond()) .. "/sec"
	end)

	-- the illusion: a +gain popup every 0.1s
	task.spawn(function()
		local step = 1 / StatsConfig.PassiveClicks
		while true do
			task.wait(step)
			local character = player.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if attr("Loaded", false) and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				popup("+" .. Format.Number(passivePerSecond() * step), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), false)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- click or tap anywhere in the world to train
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			train()
		end
	end)

	-- live boost timer
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			if timeLeft("BoostEnd") > -2 then
				refresh()
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Where is each player: which world (by distance to world centers) and which
-- gym pad. Portals teleport (server checks Strength). Gym pads with a pass
-- lock get a buy prompt.
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config
local Zones = require(Config.Zones)
local Gym = require(Config.Gym)
local Monetization = require(Config.Monetization)
local Format = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Format)
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local StatService = require(script.Parent.StatService)

local ZoneService = {}

local CHECK_SECONDS = 0.25
local lastAllowed = {}
local lastTeleport = {}
local gymPads = {}

local function gameplay()
	return workspace:WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("Gameplay")
end

local function worldAt(position)
	for i = #Zones.List, 2, -1 do
		local c = Zones.List[i].Center
		if (Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z) - Vector3.new(c.X, 0, c.Z)).Magnitude < Zones.Radius then
			return i
		end
	end
	return 1
end

local function gymAt(position)
	for tier, pad in gymPads do
		local rel = pad.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		if math.abs(rel.X) <= pad.Size.X / 2 + 1 and math.abs(rel.Z) <= pad.Size.Z / 2 + 1 and rel.Y < 12 and rel.Y > -2 then
			return tier
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function hubSpawn()
	local spawnPart = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
	return if spawnPart then spawnPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) else CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
end

local function teleportTo(player, world)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	if world == 1 then
		character:PivotTo(hubSpawn())
		return
	end
	local folder = gameplay().Worlds:FindFirstChild("World" .. world)
	local spawnPart = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("WorldSpawn")
	if spawnPart then
		character:PivotTo(spawnPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
	end
end

local function tryTeleport(player, world)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile or not Zones.List[world] then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastTeleport[player] and now - lastTeleport[player] < 2 then
		return
	end
	if world > StatService.AllowedWorld(profile) then
		lastTeleport[player] = now
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Need " .. Format.Number(Zones.List[world].Required) .. " Strength for " .. Zones.List[world].Name .. " World")
		return
	end
	lastTeleport[player] = now
	teleportTo(player, world)
	Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Welcome to " .. Zones.List[world].Name .. " World! x" .. Zones.List[world].Multiplier .. " Strength here")
end

local function promptPass(player, passKey)
	local pass = Monetization.Passes[passKey]
	if StatService.OwnsPass(player, passKey) then
		return
	end
	if pass.Id==0 then
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player,pass.Name.." is not listed yet")
		return
	end
	MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, pass.Id)
end

local function setupPortals()
	for _, pad in gameplay().Portals:GetChildren() do
		local world = pad:GetAttribute("World")
		local info = Zones.List[world]
		label(pad, string.format("%s WORLD\n<font size=\"22\">Need %s Strength \u{2022} x%d</font>", string.upper(info.Name), Format.Number(info.Required), info.Multiplier), Vector3.new(0, 9, 0))
		pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
			if player then
				tryTeleport(player, world)
			end
		end)
	end
	for _, folder in gameplay().Worlds:GetChildren() do
		local back = folder:FindFirstChild("ReturnPortal")
		if back then
			label(back, "BACK TO HUB", Vector3.new(0, 8, 0))
			back.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
				if player then
					tryTeleport(player, 1)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function setupGym()
	for _, pad in gameplay().GymPads:GetChildren() do
		local tier = pad:GetAttribute("Tier")
		local info = Gym.Tiers[tier]
		if info then
			gymPads[tier] = pad
			local need = if info.Pass then Monetization.Passes[info.Pass].Name else (if (info.Rebirths or 0) > 0 then info.Rebirths .. " Rebirths" else "FREE")
			label(pad, string.format("%s\n<font color=\"#9BFF8A\">x%d STRENGTH</font>\n<font size=\"20\">%s</font>", string.upper(info.Name), info.Multiplier, need), Vector3.new(0, 8, 0))
			if info.Pass then
				local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
				prompt.Name = "BuyPrompt"
				prompt.ActionText = "Unlock " .. info.Name
				prompt.ObjectText = "x" .. info.Multiplier .. " Strength"
				prompt.HoldDuration = 0
				prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
				prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
				prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.F
				prompt.Parent = pad
				prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
					promptPass(player, info.Pass)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function check(player)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not profile or not root then
		return
	end
	local allowed = StatService.AllowedWorld(profile)
	if lastAllowed[player] and allowed > lastAllowed[player] then
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, Zones.List[allowed].Name .. " World unlocked! Take the portal in the hub")
	end
	lastAllowed[player] = allowed

	local world = worldAt(root.Position)
	if world > allowed then
		teleportTo(player, 1)
		world = 1
	end
	local gymTier = if world == 1 then gymAt(root.Position) else nil
	if gymTier and not StatService.GymUnlocked(player, gymTier) then
		gymTier = nil
	end
	StatService.SetLocation(player, world, gymTier)
end

function ZoneService.Start()
	setupPortals()
	setupGym()
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastAllowed[player] = nil
		lastTeleport[player] = nil
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(CHECK_SECONDS)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				check(player)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return ZoneService

-- Gamepass ownership + the ONE ProcessReceipt for the whole game.
-- Grants happen only here, on the server. The client only opens Roblox prompts.
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local RebirthService = require(script.Parent.RebirthService)
local PunchService = require(script.Parent.PunchService)
local EggService = require(script.Parent.EggService)

local MonetizationService = {}

local function grantStrength(player, product)
	StatService.AddStrength(player, StatService.Gain(player) * product.Clicks)
end

local function grantCoins(player, product)
	StatService.AddCoins(player, math.max(PunchService.CoinsPerPunch(player), 10) * product.Punches)
end

local function timed(field)
	return function(player, product)
		local profile = DataService.Get(player)
		profile[field] = math.max(profile[field], os.time()) + product.Seconds
		StatService.Refresh(player)
	end
end

local grants = {
	StrengthSmall = grantStrength,
	StrengthMedium = grantStrength,
	StrengthLarge = grantStrength,
	CoinsSmall = grantCoins,
	CoinsMedium = grantCoins,
	CoinsLarge = grantCoins,
	Boost = timed("BoostEnd"),
	CoinBoost = timed("CoinBoostEnd"),
	LuckBoost = timed("LuckEnd"),
	Level = function(player)
		StatService.AddLevels(player, 1)
	end,
	RebirthSkip = function(player)
		return RebirthService.DoRebirth(player, false)
	end,
	WorldSkip = function(player)
		local profile = DataService.Get(player)
		if StatService.AllowedWorld(profile) >= #Zones.List then return false end
		profile.WorldUnlocked = StatService.AllowedWorld(profile) + 1
		StatService.Refresh(player)
	end,
	MegaEgg = function(player)
		return EggService.Hatch(player, "Mega", 1, false, true)
	end,
	UltraEgg = function(player)
		return EggService.Hatch(player, "Ultra", 1, false, true)
	end,
}

local receiptBusy={}
local function processReceiptUnlocked(info)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(info.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	-- Already granted earlier: only confirm once it is saved
	if DataService.HasReceipt(profile, info.PurchaseId) then
		if DataService.Save(player) then
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local productKey, product = Monetization.FindProduct(info.ProductId)
	if not productKey or not grants[productKey] then
		warn("[Monetization] Unknown product " .. tostring(info.ProductId))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local ok, granted = pcall(grants[productKey], player, product)
	if not ok or granted == false then
		warn("[Monetization] Grant deferred: " .. tostring(granted))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	DataService.AddReceipt(profile, info.PurchaseId)
	Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Thanks! " .. product.Name .. " received")

	if DataService.Save(player) then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
end

local function processReceipt(info)
	local id=tostring(info.PlayerId)
	while receiptBusy[id] do task.wait() end
	receiptBusy[id]=true
	local ok,result=pcall(processReceiptUnlocked,info)
	receiptBusy[id]=nil
	if not ok then warn("[Monetization] Receipt deferred: "..tostring(result));return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet end
	return result
end
